Name: Elianna's Tactical Supply Pack
Desc: Elianna's tactical supply pack. Inside are 1 expired serum, half a roll of filthy bandages, a small storage device with starship floor plans, and an empty compressed biscuit wrapper. Valen's contact information and her name are written carefully on the wrapper. Elianna used the last of her strength to press the door-close button. She had no time to leave any final words.

Name: Memory
Desc: The storage device was found below the communications tower. Someone must have dropped it there on purpose, using the tough fabric from an F.O.S. instructor uniform as a makeshift parachute. The device barely still works, and inside is a short video.

Name: Valen
Desc: Elianna, I'm sorry. I can't keep my promise. I couldn't save El or Toby... Haha. Though I'll be seeing them soon enough. But we did it! We protected the communications tower!

Name: Valen
Desc: I do still regret one thing. I promised I'd take you to that restaurant in Babylonia... I don't even know how things are there now. I just hope it's still open when you make it back.

Name: Valen
Desc: Try that grilled fish for me, okay? It looked so good in the ad!

Name: Valen
Desc: Cough... All right. I think that's everything. My account password is your birthday. Use whatever money is left however you want. It's probably the last thing I can give you. So... I guess this is goodbye.

Name: Valen
Desc: He leans closer to the camera. His face is streaked with blood, but his eyes are still gentle.

Name: Valen
Desc: Elianna, don't follow me too soon. Take your time. Go back to Babylonia and grow old happy. But let me be selfish just this once... please don't forget me.

Name: Valen
Desc: I'll be waiting for you at the end of the stars. That's where we'll meet again.

Name: Vanessa
Desc: According to Elianna's map, the warehouse should be right here...

Name: Construct Soldier A
Desc: Commandant Vanessa, I advise against going in. The Punishing Virus levels inside are extremely high...

Name: Vanessa
Desc: Then what am I supposed to do, use you as the heavy cannon? Find a way to open that door.

Name: Construct Soldier B
Desc: Y-yes...

Name: Construct Soldier A
Desc: Cover us! There are too many of them! Re-retreat!

Name: Vanessa
Desc: Retreat? Are you kidding me? Gather supplies! Take everything you can! Ugh...

Name: Construct Soldier B
Desc: Commandant Vanessa! You're hurt!

Name: Vanessa
Desc: Quit talking and move! Take everything you can carry! The heavy cannon, and that ammo crate too! Hurry!

Name: Tactical Supply Pack
Desc: Tactical supply packs are scattered across the ground. This one has a tiny cat badge pinned to it. Along with the standard supplies, there's also a broken handheld game console inside.

Name: Tactical Supply Pack
Desc: This tactical supply pack is soaked with blood. Inside is a small note torn from a notebook. It says:

Name: Tactical Supply Pack
Desc: No one cares when a mayfly dies. No one will care when I die either. Everything rises. Everything falls.

Name: Tactical Supply Pack
Desc: Another tactical pack has a hidden row of large-caliber rounds and some illegally modified gun parts. That's a serious violation of F.O.S. school rules!

Name: Tactical Supply Pack
Desc: But... where did their owners go?

Name: Half a Cookie
Desc: Half a dusty cracker lies in the ruins. One side still bears the mark of someone gripping it tightly.

Name: Half a Cookie
Desc: In a place this short on supplies, who could afford to throw away half a cracker?

Name: Dandelion
Desc: A few dandelions sway in the institute's flowerbed. They're small and crooked, their leaves tinged with sickly yellow.

Name: Dandelion
Desc: But they've stayed alive in the flowerbed, quietly watching it all.

Name: Growth Record Box
Desc: Lucia's "Growth Record Box," filled with keepsakes from every stage of her childhood.

Name: Growth Record Box
Desc: Her first drawing. Her first crayon, worn down to a stub. The report card from her first exam. The first scrapbook she ever made. And more...

Name: Growth Record Box
Desc: A headset that was just placed inside, along with an admission letter from F.O.S. College.

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: REPORT: During a recent rotation training flight to the ground, the college's Airborne Command Post was hijacked midair. The attackers planned to crash it into Bifrost.

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: In more encouraging news, during the incident, two cadets on airborne duty worked with ground communications staff and several students to stop the armed hijackers' plan.

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: The injured survivors have been taken to F.O.S. College Hospital. The college and its partner insurers are providing the maximum compensation available to the crew members who lost their lives.

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: Bifrost and the damaged F.O.S. Training Grounds are currently under repair. Students who need to make reservations should use Training Grounds 8 through 11 instead...

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: Up next, another news report.

Name: Notebook
Desc: A notebook containing a handwritten copy of the F.O.S. Anthem, marked with edits, notes, and cross-outs.

Name: Notebook
Desc: Beware, the stars above are fading. The robes of forerunners stained with blood.

Name: Notebook
Desc: Goodbye dear mother say a prayer to the stars. The time to sail away is here.

Name: Notebook
Desc: Visions... shared from golden days. Onward to a glorious tomorrow.

Name: Notebook
Desc: A new path rising from the ashes of old.

Name: Notebook
Desc: They're footprints of our countless forerunners.

Name: On the F.O.S. Deck
Desc: On the smoke-scorched, battle-damaged deck of F.O.S., someone wrote those words in blood.

Name: On the F.O.S. Deck
Desc: "No one who lights a torch in the dark should ever be forgotten."

Name: F.O.S. Student
Desc: Can you... still get up?

Name: F.O.S. Student
Desc: If you can still stand... let's move.

Name: F.O.S. Student
Desc: We need to activate the beacon inside the F.O.S. Monument, and then...

Name: F.O.S. Student
Desc: Homeward.

Name: Orange Cat
Desc: A plump orange cat has slipped into the group.

Name: Orange Cat
Desc: It still hasn't gotten used to the roar of Alpha's motorcycle, and would rather rest whenever the group stops along the way.

Name: Orange Cat
Desc: Sometimes it naps lightly and cautiously. Other times it sprawls onto its back and sleeps without a care in the world.

Name: Orange Cat
Desc: As for the "companions" it has to live with, it dislikes the white cat, but as long as they keep their distance, things stay peaceful. The gray cat, though... it actually likes that one, and sometimes runs over just to bite its butt.

Name: Orange Cat
Desc: It doesn't really like the new cat food. Maybe because it isn't roasted like the old one, so it lacks that crispy smell and texture.

Name: Orange Cat
Desc: So now it's eating about three pounds less every day. At this rate, it should slim down soon.

█████▄▃▂▄▃▂research█▂▄██Sefirah▇▃█▂testing▇▃█▂▂▄█...

Name: Atlantic Calamity Major Incident Report
Desc: At approximately 16:52 on ██/██/2160, an extremely severe laboratory accident occurred at the Atlantic Eye located in EOA-01 sector, Central Atlantic, triggering a massive chain explosion and devastating the area...\nDirect Cause of the Incident\n██████████████████

Name: Atlantic Calamity Major Incident Report
Desc:
Analysis of Contributing Factors
1. Developer failed to implement proper protocols for production quality and safety.
2. Regulatory departments failed to fulfill supervisory duties during the research process.
3. Security screening and personnel verification procedures in the core area were severely neglected.
██████████████████

Name: Atlantic Calamity Major Incident Report
Desc: Recommendations for Disciplinary Actions Against Responsible Parties\nFollowing the investigation, it is recommended that no further action be taken against the primary responsible parties, as they perished in the incident. Among the remaining personnel, 76 individuals have been held accountable, with several transferred to the World Government Control Court for further investigation...

Name: Transatlantic Economic Community
Desc: The ocean is the cradle of life.\nRelying on the vast seas surrounding them, the regions along the Atlantic Rim entered an age of exploration and developed highly advanced trade networks. During the Great Depression, these fragmented territories maintained frequent exchanges, yet conflicts over interests never ceased. Years of warfare brought endless suffering and scars that would endure for generations.

Name: Transatlantic Economic Community
Desc: With the full support of the great families, the Transatlantic achieved regional unification. Before entering the Golden Age, its various territories reached reconciliation, established the United Foundation, signed the Jareit Accord, and formed the Transatlantic Economic Community, an alliance built on trade and commerce that transformed the Atlantic coast from division toward cooperation and shared prosperity.

Name: Transatlantic Economic Community
Desc: During the Golden Age, the TEC flourished with towering skyscrapers across its cities and breakthroughs in scientific research emerging one after another. The region actively participated in major projects such as the development of Gestalt, orbital satellite construction, and the Olympus Project.

Name: Erhorn Family
Desc: The leading family of the Four Great Families during the Golden Age, the Erhorn family dominates the financial sector and pioneered the United Foundation. Through financial capital and insurance systems, they distributed risk across the entire collective, binding the fates of the Transatlantic families together through economic ties.

Name: Erhorn Family
Desc: Beyond that, the Erhorn family secretly influences the media landscape of the TEC. The Transatlantic Herald is one of the many enterprises under its control.

Name: Helio Family
Desc: One of the Four Great Families' energy and infrastructure conglomerates, the Helio Family supplies the power behind the development of maritime and terrestrial resources across the Transatlantic, as well as the continued growth of its islands.

Name: Helio Family
Desc: In engineering, the Helio family has long been synonymous with precision and reliability. The Atlantic Eye, a miracle of engineering conceived and realized by the family, stands as their greatest achievement. After its completion, they worked closely with the Erhorn family to construct lighthouses, undersea tunnels, and optical cable networks throughout the TEC.

Name: Spelmin Family
Desc: A cornerstone of North Atlantic shipping, the Spelmin family is the most specialized of the Four Great Families in terms of business. They control Port Podesta, the finest harbor in the North Atlantic. With the support of the Helio and Copperfield families, the Spelmin family transformed Port Podesta into a mobile harbor at the end of the Golden Age.

Name: Spelmin Family
Desc: Thanks to the decisions made by the current head of the family, Tavis, the Spelmin family began expanding into the fields of life sciences and M.I.N.D. research.

Name: Copperfield Family
Desc: As the only new power to enter the ranks of the Four Great Families during the Golden Age, the Copperfield family has accumulated extensive expertise in bionic machinery and cultural entertainment.

Name: Copperfield Family
Desc: In the early Golden Age, the Copperfield family gained recognition across the TEC through its distinctive Copperfield Aquarium. Later, riding the wave of advances in bionic machinery technology, the family rapidly rose to become one of the Four Great Families.

Name: Copperfield Family
Desc: However, as a newly risen power, the Copperfield family faced years of hostility from the established families. By forging alliances with the Spelmin and Helio families, the Copperfields eventually secured their place among the Four Great Families.

Name: Huhu's TV Infomercial
Desc: Tired of worrying about polluted air and unsafe water? The Copperfield family presents its latest breakthrough innovation—Huhu!

Name: Huhu's TV Infomercial
Desc: Meet Huhu, the civilian-grade bionic pet that's cute, cuddly, and unbelievably smart! Just having a Huhu around helps keep your air fresh and your water clean. It's incredible! No feeding. No mess. No hassle. Order today! Originally ████, now only 1███!

Name: Huhu's TV Infomercial
Desc: Mommy! I want a Huhu too!\nAvailable at Copperfield Family department stores across the Transatlantic.

Name: "Understanding"
Desc:
Time: ███
Location: ███
Identity Information... ██ Resolved:
Science Council Chief Technician — Dominik
Patriarch of the Erhorn Family of the Transatlantic Economic Community — Arius Erhorn

Name: Dominik
Desc: "███" ███ lacked a vessel, so... you chose yourself.

Name: Arius
Desc: Cough... it's you, Dominik. Of course... how could it be anyone else...

Name: Arius
Desc: This miserable end I've come to... I suppose it's only... ██████, isn't it?

Name: Arius
Desc: What's happening outside right now... how is it?

Name: Dominik
Desc: Many people died because of you.

Name: Arius
Desc: Heh... don't tell me you're ██ing them.

Name: Dominik
Desc: ...You still have a chance to live.

Name: Arius
Desc: ...Even if only for a moment, I saw it... I ███ everything.

Name: Arius
Desc: Tell me, Dominik, if it were you, could you bear the "██"██?

Name: Dominik
Desc: ...Don't speak. You're badly wounded.

Name: Arius
Desc: ███... that's enough...

Name: Arius
Desc: Human's ███... so fragile...

Name: Balder Scale Model
Desc: This model faithfully recreates every design detail of the Balder, the TEC's heavy amphibious assault frigate. Assembled from photo-etched metal parts and precision components, its onboard aircraft and radar arrays feature accurate color-separation, perfectly capturing the imposing presence of this legendary warship.

Name: Balder Scale Model
Desc: Commissioned at great expense by the Transatlantic during the Golden Age as an "unsinkable vessel," the Balder was launched in the late Golden Age. Combining regional air defense, anti-submarine warfare, and precision land-strike capabilities, it marked a new era in Transatlantic military power projecting into the open seas.

Name: Balder Scale Model
Desc: However, in 2150, as the World Government confiscated military assets across the globe, the Balder was restricted to drydock at Port Podesta Shipyard, placed under the stewardship of the Spelmin family.

Name: A Letter Found in Helentine's Diary
Desc: The envelope has faded and yellowed with age, but Helentine has always kept it tucked behind the cover of her notebook.

Name: Ophelia
Desc:
Dear Helentine,
I'm writing this letter to tell you...
Due to my work, I may not be able to return home for a very long time.
Things here are even more complicated than they were back in Port Podesta. So... it may still take a long, long time before I can come back.

Name: Ophelia
Desc: All this time, I've been wondering...\nWhile you had forgotten the past, did I do a good job of becoming your "sister”? That's right... I was trying to become the sister you once were.

Name: Ophelia
Desc: This is my first time doing something like this. Whether I did it well or not... I honestly don't know. I may not be able to return for a very, very long time. But by now, you must have learned how to live your own life well, haven't you?

Name: Ophelia
Desc: You still have a long, long life ahead of you. As for me... perhaps I'll be no more than a brief moment in all that time. But if the short time we shared left even a small mark on your heart...

Name: Ophelia
Desc: Then maybe that's enough to carry me through the long years apart. Sister... Helentine... I hope your days ahead are filled with more happiness than you can count!
